app_store.name: GleeLounge: Party Games
app_store.subtitle: Phones are the controllers
app_store.promotional_text: Every game free, every player, up to 8. No account, no install — a 4-letter code and you are playing. A locked phone never ends the round anymore.
app_store.description:
GleeLounge turns any screen into a party console. Open it on a TV, laptop or tablet, and everyone joins from their own phone. No app to install, no account to make, no card to enter.

WHAT YOU GET
- 7 original games and counting: Reaction Duel, Word Sprint, Draw & Guess, Quiz Party, Karts, Bomber Arena and Simon Echo.
- Up to 8 players in the same room, playing at once.
- Every game free. No ads, no paywall, no "unlock the rest" screen.
- Your phone is the controller: tap, tilt, draw, type, steer.

BUILT TO SURVIVE THE ROOM
Phones lock. Calls come in. People wander off and come back. GleeLounge remembers you: reopen the link, type your name, and you are back in the same round with your score intact. The party never gets kicked.

ANY SCREEN IS THE CONSOLE
A smart-TV browser, a laptop on the coffee table, an iPad, a monitor with an HDMI cable. If it opens a website, it is the big screen.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open GleeLounge on the big screen. A 4-letter room code appears.
2. Everyone joins from their phone by scanning the QR code or typing the code.
3. Pick a game and play. Switch games any time.

PLAY SOLO OR TOGETHER
Some games play solo, and the big screen takes a keyboard when a phone is not handy. Otherwise, grab whoever is around.

Free for everyone, and it stays that way. If you love it you can support it, but nothing is ever locked behind a price.
app_store.whats_new: First release. Seven original games, up to 8 players, and a reconnect that survives a locked phone.
